samira khan: Hey @people-ops planning to spend 2 months in Dublin (2024-11-01 to 2024-12-31) to support my partner's relocation. Quick checklist: 1) Is WFH stipend prorated for a 2-month temp homebase? 2) Any payroll/tax exposure for Redwood for a 60-day stay in Ireland? 3) Can IT ship my laptop and a UK/EU power adapter to the AirBnB? 4) Will my US-based health benefits and HSA access continue while I'm over there? 5) If I take a one-off paid local workshop (small honorarium), does that change anything?
maya (people-ops): Thanks Samira  please submit a Temporary Homebase form (https://intranet.redwood/work-remote). Short answers: stipend prorated by days; payroll/legal need to confirm nexus; IT can attempt vendor-managed ship; benefits typically continue but check telemedicine/prescription rules. For honorarium: that could create local tax reporting obligations.
samira khan: Form submitted and address attached. Role while there: internal infra + one public paid workshop (honorarium under 
00 EUR). No client work.
sanjay (payroll): FYI: Ireland has a 183-day residency rule but employer obligations (PAYE, USC) can arise for local income or if you perform paid work to Irish residents. A small honorarium could trigger local reporting even if under thresholds. We'll run a nexus check after legal advises. Don't change bank details.
nora (legal): Looping legal: small local payments (honoraria) are often taxable locally and can create withholding obligations for the payor. If the workshop organizer is local and will pay you locally, that may be a separate tax matter. We'll open a quick advisory with our external tax counsel. Please confirm whether the workshop pay will be routed via Redwood or directly to you.
samira khan: Workshop pay will be paid directly by the meetup organizer to my personal PayPal. I can decline if it's risky. I mainly want to avoid creating company obligations.
nora (legal): If it's paid to you personally by a local organizer, that reduces employer withholding risk but may create a personal tax filing need. It still could attract attention if combined with company activities. We'll confirm with counsel.
it-ops: For shipping: choose "international ship" on the form. Our vendor will try corporate PO import to minimize VAT. If vendor can't ship to the exact address, we can ship to a local courier hub or you can pick up at a vendor-designated location. Allow 7-12 business days. If you need an EU power adapter only, IT can send that separately.
benefits-team: Medical: your US benefits remain active while on US payroll. Telemedicine is available globally but prescriptions vary; HSA contributions continue while you're on US payroll but using funds overseas has different network coverage. If you need in-person care, keep receipts for potential reimbursement and notify benefits-team about any planned prescriptions.
maya (people-ops): Next steps: 1) legal opens advisory with tax counsel (nora) 2) payroll runs nexus check (sanjay) 3) IT schedules vendor ship if you pick that option (it-ops). We'll update this thread within 3 business days. If counsel flags risk and you still want to travel, we can offer a provisional note for housing but it's at your risk until payroll/legal confirm.
samira khan: Thanks all  I'll hold off on accepting the honorarium until we hear back. If counsel says OK for personal receipt of the small fee, I'll take it and keep receipts. Appreciate the fast replies. :pray: 
hr-bot: AUTOMATED REMINDER: Temporary homebase requests must be submitted >=15 business days before departure. Required attachments: travel dates, temporary address, visa/permit if applicable, and any third-party payment details. See https://intranet.redwood/forms/temp-remote
